Variants.Content: Harroway () is a town and river port node in the river network. The river brought it shipping, fish, mill power, and markets, but also made it more vulnerable than a mountain castle to floods, ford battles, and marches. People here rely on warehouses, docks, boatmen, agricultural products, and business travel; the nobles value its ability to control goods, taxes, and river news. There is no wide natural barrier in the Riverlands, and waterways are often both the bloodline of wealth and the fastest route to war.

Entry Lord Harroway's Town Local families also relied on river transportation, ferries, wheat fields, mills, and hiding places when war came; if any road, well, spring, or dock failed, the price would fall first on them.

Entry Lord Harroway's Town If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Lord Harroway's Town A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Lord Harroway's Town They care about river transportation, ferries, wheat fields, mills, and hiding places when war comes. They also care about whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
